1659-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4518-5295.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7054--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2921-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-2921-6458.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-7824.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-7704.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Doc Samson.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-7704.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

3693-6919-7704.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doc Samson.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-6919-7704.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5879-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

454-1978-7488.description:
Cause Topiary Lecturer to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1792-2510-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-2510-4404.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
457-1792-2510-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Semblance Anvil.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2921-3685-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
2921-3685-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-2932-5220-5256.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2167-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Squandered Resources ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

224-1031-1846-6618-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1031-1846-6618-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Invocation of the Founders triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Invocation of the Founders ability.
Resolve the copy of Invocation of the Founders's ability, copying the Relm's Sketching spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

1365-1651-6701-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-6701-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to different creatures you control
attached to different creatures you control

1475-6068.description:
Activate Dissection Tools' equip ability by sacrificing the creature it is attached to, targeting any other creature, ensuring to not select the creature with One with the Kami attached, if able.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to the targeted creature.
Repeat.
1475-6068.notes: If you start the combo controlling no additional creatures, you will need to attach Dissection Tools to the creature that has One with the Kami attached. On the next iteration, you will then sacrifice a Spirit token and attach Dissection Tools to a different Spirit token. You can then follow the above steps as listed for all subsequent iterations.

1987-3277-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3277-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Izzet Chronarch.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2281-2292-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

5256-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-5663--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the persist creature's power.
Repeat.

751-907-2653-3314.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-3565-4786.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
575-3565-4786.description:
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Claws of Gix ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1591-2634-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
1591-2634-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

662-1102-1636-3197.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
662-1102-1636-3197.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Herd Baloth to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2959.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Heat Shimmer
141-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Heat Shimmer, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-396-1806-2232-4277.description:
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling Eternal Scourge from your hand, adding {2}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile for {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio's trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
The token enters, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Eternal Scourge from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-957-1309.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

776-1329-1482-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1482-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Jeweled Lotus to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
